illustrations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one editorial software architecture image study for Sebastian Consulting, landscape 4:3.
Input image: Image 1 is ONLY a material, lighting, color, and rendering style reference. Create the new subject specified below, not a duplicate of its geometry.
Scene/backdrop: continuous nearly white warm-neutral studio floor and backdrop, approximately #f9f8f6, no horizon line. No pink field, no peach, no beige color wash. Soft neutral gray contact shadows only.
Style/medium: premium restrained photorealistic industrial-design visualization of an abstract software system. Fine matte surface texture, tiny crisp chamfers, elegant deliberate geometry. A physically coherent abstract model, not a building, furniture, toy, or real computer hardware.
Materials/colors: graphite gray, warm off-white, restrained satin brushed aluminum, and limited translucent smoke-gray glass. Deep burgundy only in one or two very small flush accents, less than three percent of the object. No colored glow or pink light spill.
Architecture discipline: a clear orthogonal grid, consistent repeated module dimensions, equal intervals, precise alignment, and a readable hierarchy. Every component has an intentional relationship to the whole. No arbitrary shapes, haphazard offsets, asymmetrical piles, or ornamental complexity.
Composition: one coherent isolated assembly, fully visible, occupying about 65 to 70 percent of the frame, generous off-white breathing room. Elevated three-quarter near-orthographic view, around 35 degrees above the ground, showing the arrangement and component boundaries. Soft directional studio illumination from upper left, delicate neutral shadow, same quiet visual family as the reference.
Text: none.
Avoid: plants, nature, wood, household props, people, buildings, rooms, windows, doors, stairs, architectural columns, rails; electronics, servers, chips, circuits, cables; watercolor, ink outlines, UI screens, flat flowcharts, arrows, symbols, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, neon, floating magical parts, clutter.
Subject: A single square graphite platform holding six identical low off-white modules in a perfect two-by-three grid, with uniform narrow gaps. The modules align on a precise orthogonal grid. A slender satin-metal common spine runs through the center gap and six equal short connections meet the modules. One thin smoked-glass sheet beneath the modules exposes the common infrastructure. Only the central spine has a tiny burgundy insert. A calm unified composition with clear repetition.
